import analysis.calculus.deriv
import data.real.basic
import data.set.lattice
import order.concave

open real set

theorem lg_target : StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) fun x => √x := by
  have h_diff : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi 0, differentiableAt ℝ (fun x => √x) x :=
    assume x hx, by simp [differentiableAt, deriv_sqrt]

  have h_second_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi 0, (deriv (deriv (fun x => √x)) x) < 0 :=
    assume x hx, by simp [deriv, deriv_sqrt, deriv_deriv_sqrt, zero_lt_one, mul_neg, pow_two]

  exact StrictConcaveOn.of_neg_second_deriv h_second_deriv
